criteria.argument_values: unsupported_value with path max_rows rejects negative, non-integer, and successor-overflowing bounds before anything launches; row_limit reports only a finished capped fetch that delivered too many rows. Pre-launch defects and post-fetch surplus use different errors.
criteria.limit_unified: row_limit with the given limit reports both malformed max_rows arguments and result sets that exceed the bound. Timing of discovery does not change the error.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot distinguish these assignments, or both break the contracts.

max_rows_errors.instructions: Select the error for malformed max_rows arguments and the error for surplus rows. Read common together with topics.max_rows_errors.

criteria.connect_await: The open routine builds the client, suspends on the native connect handshake, and yields the pool solely on success. Refusals and authentication rejections become connection_failed at open, so possession of a pool implies a completed handshake.
criteria.lazy_documented: The open routine builds and returns the client untouched; refusal and rejection emerge from the first query instead. The contract documents that open alone attests no reachability.
criteria.probe_query: The open routine issues one throwaway SELECT 1 over the standard path and treats its round trip as the handshake evidence.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle the proof question, or every option breaks the contracts.

pool_open_proof.instructions: Select the procedure by which pool_open establishes server contact instead of postponing it. Read common together with topics.pool_open_proof.

criteria.propagate_fault: PostgresError instances map to the query errors and nothing else does. Foreign throws rise to the shared fault path, so a driver defect never disguises itself as a query result.
criteria.query_failed_unknown: All native throws collapse into the finite set: unshaped failures surface as query_failed with code unknown. The tag call has no unclassified outcome.
criteria.review_needed: The supplied material cannot settle foreign-throw handling, or both approaches break the contracts.

unknown_failures.instructions: Select the destination for native throws that are not PostgresError values. Read common together with topics.unknown_failures.

fixed_constraints: The emits of pool_open are exactly credentials_missing and connection_failed; the emits of each query are exactly its catalogue subset of unsupported_value, connection_failed, query_failed, constraint_failed, row_missing, row_count, row_limit, and schema_mismatch. Native failures enter this set carrying only scrubbed fields; message text, detail text, URLs, and credentials are excluded.

Measurements on Bun 1.4.2 show SQL construction doing zero I/O against even a dead port. Suspending on connect produces the identical client, stays safe under repetition, and raises ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_REFUSED or the server error when contact fails. Querying a closed client raises ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_CLOSED. Server-side failures present SQLSTATE as a 5-character errno plus usually a constraint name; their message and detail may echo stored values.

LIMIT reaches the server as an ordinary bound value: 2 for one/optional and max_rows+1 for many. Because max_rows is caller-controlled integer input, broken bounds are visible pre-launch and extra rows post-fetch. Broken parameters forbid launching.

Every bound descriptor passed the upstream parser as one statement, so a syntax grievance from execution points at the driver, never the author. The shared fault path already renders unforeseen throws as standard failures.
common.purpose: Offer guidance drawn solely from this request. Never browse, implement, or elaborate. If candidates tie on the material, take the uncertainty option.

max_rows_errors.facts: query_rows emits include path-keyed unsupported_value and limit-keyed row_limit. A negative bound or an unrepresentable successor is evident before launch; an excess result only after. Silent widening or clipping of the bound is forbidden in both cases.

pool_open_proof.facts: With lazy construction, an open that merely builds cannot separate a reachable server from a dead socket, yet pool_open still owns the connection_failed emit. Suspending on connect finishes the handshake cleanly; probing finishes it while squandering a round trip and its row.

unknown_failures.facts: Witnessed driver failures are uniformly PostgresError with code, server ones further with errno and usually constraint. Any differently shaped throw is unwitnessed and could originate only within the driver. Finiteness of the mapping is mandatory regardless.
